title: Cursor pagination for article listings
prompt:
Clients paging through /articles keep reporting duplicated and missing articles whenever something gets published while they page, and articles published in the same second come back in a different order from one request to the next. We've agreed to move the listing to opaque-cursor pagination; the full design is in docs/pagination.md, please implement it across the layers (repository, service, API, errors).

In short:
- ArticleService.list_articles(limit=20, cursor=None, author=None, status=None) returns a Page dataclass (defined in articles/service.py) with items and next_cursor.
- Order is published_at descending, then id descending, everywhere.
- A cursor marks a position, not an offset, so articles inserted or deleted while a client pages don't cause duplicates or skips. next_cursor is None when nothing matching is left after the page.
- A cursor is tied to the author/status filters it was created with; using it with different filters, or passing any string that isn't one of our cursors, raises a new InvalidCursorError (a ValidationError subclass in articles/errors.py). limit is an int from 1 to 100.
- ArticleService.list_page keeps working for existing callers, unchanged apart from the new ordering, but emits a DeprecationWarning on every call.
- ArticlesApi.handle_list switches to cursor mode by default (limit, cursor, author, status -> {"items", "next_cursor"}), keeps the old response when page or per_page is sent, and answers 400 with {"error": ...} for mixed or invalid parameters.

The doc has the exact rules for each of these; the existing tests in tests/ must keep passing.
acceptance: Page type and default limit; order with ties (published_at desc, id desc) across every page size; no cursor when exactly exhausted; empty results; author/status filters; limit change between pages; URL-safe cursor; keyset stability under inserts before/after the cursor and deletion of the cursor row; cursor bound to filters; garbage and foreign base64 cursors raise InvalidCursorError (a ValidationError); limit/status validation incl. bool and float; legacy list_page warns on every call and returns the old shape with the new order; API cursor mode default, paging with filters, empty cursor param, 400 cases incl. mixed modes, legacy mode.
difficulty_rationale: An interface migration across four modules with keyset pagination, tie-breaking, filter-bound opaque cursors, robust cursor rejection, a deprecated wrapper and two API modes; a first attempt using offsets or a published_at-only cursor fails the stability and tie tests.
